description: Find PumpPill's read for a query: a Robinhood Chain address (0x + 40 hex), a Solana mint (base58), or a ticker such as HOOD. Returns ids for fetch. For a ticker the result is the one Robinhood Chain contract that clears the gate (alive, $10K+ pool, not flagged HIGH or CRITICAL) with the count of others using the name, then Solana tokens PumpPill holds under that exact name, marked as name matches. No results is an honest miss, not a clean bill. A question in words (how do exits work, what is a liquidity lock) searches PumpPill's lessons at /learn instead and returns learn:<slug> ids with a matching passage.
name: search
title: Search PumpPill's index
